findings: The hero circle on the right is thin-stroked and sparse — the single blue dot inside a large empty orbit risks reading as underfilled negative space rather than a fully resolved graphic; it leans on the type to carry the composition.
The mono utility captions (TELOS · ANDREMACEDO.COM, coupling readouts) are set very small and dense; in places the interface-labeling gets close to decorative texture rather than legible signal.
The lower-page long-form 'Lab Notes' / 'Consciousness Stream' sections collapse toward a straight single-column wall of text, less compositionally considered than the top half.
what_works: Genuine editorial voice: high-contrast Didone-style display serif ('No conductor. No score. One pulse.') paired with a mono utility register — an intentional pairing no SaaS template reaches for.
The italic blue 'pulse' as the lone chromatic accent against a warm cream ground is disciplined color restraint governed by a single hue.

Asymmetric hero (heavy type block left, orbital diagram right) plus the numbered index tables ('Ten Obsessions', 'The Common Time', roman-numeral epochs) build a magazine/dossier structure, not a centered-hero-plus-three-cards layout.
The embedded black pendulum panel and coupling slider read as a living instrument rather than garnish, tying the visual system to the page's concept.
A.reasoning: This is clearly not template-grade slop: it commits to an editorial-magazine identity with a high-contrast serif against mono, a single restrained blue accent on cream, asymmetric composition, and interactive/diagrammatic elements that a default generator would not produce. Hierarchy is unambiguous with the display headline owning the first viewport. It falls short of top marks because the hero's right-side circle feels sparse and the lower long-form sections thin out into denser single-column text with less compositional tension, but the decisive typographic and structural moves comfortably clear the bar.

findings: hero text left-aligned with large empty circle right creates deliberate asymmetry rather than centered default
blue accent used only for key phrases and links, never as decorative gradient or glow
pendulum canvas and numbered list of lockings use minimal iconography without added shadows or borders
dense body text blocks maintain consistent measure and leading without ad-hoc size jumps
what_works: hero composition pairs large serif-adjacent display with off-axis circle and micro interactive dots
restrained single blue accent governs all emphasis without competing hues
live pendulum demo sits inside text flow as functional instrument rather than illustration
B.reasoning: Desktop render shows an editorial, text-dense layout with intentional left-right tension in the hero and sparse use of a single blue accent; no centered SaaS template, no uniform decoration, and no default system-sans monotony. The pendulum interaction and numbered case studies further differentiate it from generic AI output. Minor deductions for slightly loose vertical rhythm in lower sections and safe body typeface.
